newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line Q3 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line Q3 same-store sales rise.

text.p: Finish Line Inc said Wednesday that same-store sales for the third quarter ended November 30 were up 17 percent.
This compared with a one percent increase for the same period last year.
Net sales for the third quarter were $73.0 million, up 38 percent from $52.7 million a year ago.
For the nine months ended November 30, net sales were $235.8 million, up 39 percent from $169.5 million a year ago. On a year-to-date basis, comparable store net sales increased 16 percent.

Finish Line, a specialty retailer of men's, women's and children's brand-name athletic and leisure footwear and activewear, said it expects to continue to experience significant variability in net sales and comparable store sales from quarter to quarter.
